title: DetectionRule
description: A Guardian alert rule: a detection run on a schedule over the tenant's logs, raising alerts. Name exactly one of body, file, searchRef, countermeasure, sigmahq or ioc. body and file are the tenant's own rule; the others run a rule Guardian already has, which can be tuned (level, threshold, suppressions, timing) but not edited. A rule whose detection does not compile, or names a log source Guardian has no table for, is stored turned off. The plan caps how many rules run at once. Deleting one that an AlertTrigger still uses is refused.

displayName.description: The name the console shows. Defaults to the Sigma rule's title, or the saved search's, countermeasure's or built-in rule's name.

language.description: The language of body or file. sigma: a Sigma rule, or several in one multi-document YAML with one correlation rule, which is the one that alerts. dsl: the Guardian search language. Guardian keeps a DSL rule only as a copy of a saved search today, so a dsl body or file has no direct write path yet; use searchRef until Guardian takes DSL rule text.

body.description: The rule text, at most 256 KiB.

file.description: A file holding the rule text, the same as body.

searchRef.description: The metadata.name of a SavedSearch whose text the rule runs. Its text is copied when the rule is created: editing the search later does not change the rule.

countermeasure.description: A Vulnetix countermeasure of kind SIGMA, by uuid: the virtual patching lane's detection for a vulnerability.

sigmahq.description: A rule from the SigmaHQ catalogue Guardian imports weekly, by its path in the SigmaHQ repository. Only rules that compile are offered.

ioc.description: A built-in indicator rule. ioc-dns: a domain on an indicator list resolved. ioc-net: a connection to an indicator address.

enabled.description: Whether the rule runs. A rule that cannot compile is never on, whatever this says.

level.description: The Sigma level. Defaults to the rule's own level, or medium.

severityOverride.description: The alert severity, instead of the one the level maps to (informational to info, low to notice, medium to warning, high and critical to critical).

latenessSec.description: How long a run waits for late rows before it reads a window, in seconds.

suppressSec.description: Seconds during which a repeat of the same alert is merged into the open one instead of raising another.

maxAlertsPerRun.description: Alerts one run may raise. Beyond it, one overflow alert says how many more matched.

threshold.description: Alert only when at least count rows match within windowSec, counted per the by fields. Wraps the detection as a Sigma event_count correlation.

suppressions.description: Values that never alert. Each adds a filter on field equal to value to the rule's detection until it lapses.

until.description: The last day it applies is the day before this date (UTC). Left out, it never lapses.

target.description: Where the rule's alerts are sent, beyond the Guardian alerts list.
